categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) and scripts under ci/test/ to execute native FreeBSD CI tests instead of cross-compilation.
categories.rationale: Adds native build and test execution for FreeBSD in CI, catching platform-specific regressions before merge rather than in external nightly runs. Reviewers note that 'running tests properly in Core CI with reliable resources is preferable to dealing with noisy external nightly failures'.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests area label and modifies test/functional/test_framework/netutil.py to silence spurious lsof stderr warnings on FreeBSD.
categories.rationale: The functional test framework change is a one-line adjustment to ignore benign lsof memory allocation warnings on FreeBSD. Its impact within test infrastructure is minor and purely incidental to setting up the new CI environment.
